summary: Home Manager preserves leftover Fractal candidates and converges recorded pre-Fractal rollback layouts without manual cleanup.

schema.detail: Existing installer state and receipt formats are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: A regular leftover fractal without an install receipt can be adopted only with physical st3 matching the installer package recorded in managed binary-installer/current.json, and st absent or linking to st3. Foreign packages and unrelated symlinks remain refused.

manual.detail: Repeated pre-Fractal rollback and roll-forward requires no manual removal of leftover candidates.

recovery.detail: The leftover is moved to a unique fractal.replaced-<timestamp>.<suffix> sibling before normal receipt-aware installation. Device/inode checks bind the moved file and st/st3 to the checked layout, with a st3 content hash. Concurrent swaps refuse installation and restore without clobbering; if a new target already exists, both paths are retained and named in the refusal. Failed preservation renames never trigger binary restoration over foreign entries. Pre-Fractal generations leave the preserved sibling and newer canonical receipt intact; rolling forward validates ownership and restores reverse aliases.
